mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as capital costs fall across the economy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.5% triggers immediate market anticipation of aggressive rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as bond yields spike.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly growth in employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% and unemployment decline (UNRATE) below -0.1pp signals labor market overheating, triggering Fed tightening fears and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS rises >0.5% MoM and UNRATE falls >0.1pp MoM over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions characterized by housing market strength, rising housing starts (HOUST) above 0.8% signal sustained consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion despite HOUST growth exceeding 0.8% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) decline exceeding 0.5% signals deteriorating manufacturing activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO falls >0.5% MoM over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales (RSAFS) increase exceeding 0.8% indicates robust consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as corporate revenue growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when RSAFS rises >0.8% MoM over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly growth in housing starts (HOUST) above 0.5% and retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% signals synchronized consumer demand strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST rises >0.5% MoM and RSAFS rises >0.5% MoM over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.3% signals expanding manufacturing output, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises >0.3% MoM over a 3-year rolling window.
